No front door

Followers leave without a trace

A founder who reads “build a business (and life) you love again” and feels it, but isn’t ready to talk, has nothing to say yes to today. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

Middle mostly closed

The 95% have nothing to buy

The Collective is the right next step for earlier-stage creatives, but when it’s closed to monthly members, the people not ready for $18k don’t buy anything at all.

Qualifying costs you

Every seat depends on your time

Hand-picking 25 people through conversations means the filter is you. There is nothing that sorts the ready from the curious before they reach your inbox.

Anyone not ready for the mastermind today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass, with the Collective on the thank-you page and the mastermind application on the replay

You already have a low-ticket offer that people love. What’s missing is a front door that sends the right people to it every week, and a filter that shows you who’s ready for the mastermind.

Fixes the missing front door

A free class is an easy yes for anyone who follows you, and every sign-up is an email you keep, whether or not they buy today.

Opens the middle all year

The Collective becomes the offer straight after sign-up, so new members join every week instead of only when you open the doors.

Qualifies before you talk

Only people who watched, stayed and applied reach a call. The application asks about revenue and readiness, so your conversations are with founders in the $20k to $100k range.

The 95%*

Not ready for the mastermind yet

They join the class free, many join the Collective on the thank-you page, and they stay on your email list. You get paid to start the relationship, and the Collective covers the ad spend.

The qualified 5%

Ready for the next level

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before your calendar, and the pre-call emails warm them up for the mastermind.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.
